Commentary.Commentary: That is all we have for you from this game then. This series has certainly not set the world on fire by any means and it struggles to get any meaningful context, with Pakistan not playing their strongest XI and their bench strength not being good enough to challenge Australia. Join us on Friday, January 29, 2019 for the 4th ODI in Dubai at 3 pm local (1100 GMT) to see whether we get a different delicacy served. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!
Not surprisingly, Pat Cummins has been named the Man Of The Match. Just his second MOM award in ODIs after his first against England on Australia Day, i.e., Jan 26, 2018.

It was a welcome return from rest for Pat Cummins, demolishing the top order and not allowing Pakistan a look in. The burst that he produced allowed the other bowlers to build pressure and every bowler apart from Stoinis got at least one wicket. Adam Zampa cleaned up the tail, taking 4 wickets in his last 10 balls. Earlier in the day, Australia posted a decent 266, riding on a calm 90 by skipper Finch, a counter-attacking 47 from Peter Handscomb and a breathtaking 71 from Glenn Maxwell. They sized up the pitch well, got in and then played their shots.

There were a couple of partnerships in the middle stages of the innings, one involving Imam-ul-Haq and one involving Umar Akmal but that just delayed the inevitable. No one could hang in long out there in the middle and with the run rate mounting with every passing over, the risks came about but did not quite pay off.

On paper, 267 does not look a great target but that is where it comes a bit different in Abu Dhabi. The pitch tends to get slower as the game progresses and that is exactly how it turned out. Pakistan did not get a great start and were 16/3 by the 7th over. There itself, the run chase looked stuffed out.

Easy peasy then for Australia. Series done and dusted with 2 matches to go. Chase was the case in the first two games but not here. Pakistan have clearly not got their best side on paper but make no mistake, the Aussies were at their best.

OUT! Decision overturned  and that is the end of the match. Full length delivery on off, turning in for the right-hander. Hasnain fails to read the googly. He fails to connect the bat to the ball while defending. The ball hits his back leg. Zampa appeals but the umpire turns it down. Finch has a chat and then takes it upstairs. Hawk Eye shows the ball will hit the leg stump. A comfortable 80-run victory for Australia.
Big shout for LBW! The umpire denies it though. Hasnain has been hit in front of the stumps and Australia look confident. Review taken...
Mohammad Hasnain is the last man in.

Full and outside off, Junaid comes down the track and heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Short and outside off, spinning away, cut through the covers for a single.
Full length delivery outside off, Junaid Khan fails to put the bat on the ball.
Full on leg, works it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Same line and length, Khan this time guides it to third man for a single.
Back of a length on off, Junaid Khan guides it to third man for a double.
Full on off, defended.
A back of a length on leg, Yasir Shah looks to flick it but gets a top edge towards square leg but it falls short of Handscomb over there.
Pat Cummins is now back into the attack.
Full outside off, lets it go.
Full on off, defended.
Junaid Khan walks in at number 10, replacing Usman.

OUT! Shinwari heads to the pavilion now. Australia romping home! Flatter outside off and Usman hits it really hard and flat. The ball flies to long off where Jason Behrendorff takes a smart catch. Another two to complete the formalities here at Abu Dhabi.
Usman looks to flick this googly but fails to put bat on ball. The ball rolls towards the leg side.
Kept out off the back foot by Usman Khan.
Usman Shinwari walks in at number 9.

OUT! Imad falls now. And the last hope for Pakistan going back to the hut. A flighted delivery on off, Imad falls for the trap. Dances down the pitch and misses the ball completely. Alex Carey just whips the bails off. Hang on! Replays show us that he had collected the ball in front of the stumps but it has gone unnoticed. Not that it would have mattered much in the context of the game, but it should have been spotted.
Pulled away to mid-wicket by Yasir. No run though.
Flatter one on off, Wasim pushes it back to long on before it turns. Single taken.

Excellent effort in the deep! A flatter one on the off stump, Wasim pulls out the reverse pull. The ball flies through the vacant backward point region but goes really slowly towards the rope. Handscomb runs a lot to his right and stops the ball just inside the rope. 2 runs taken.

Flatter one on the off stump line, Yasir has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

This one drifted down the leg side, the camera zoomed on the umpire, who does not signal anything.
Full on leg, blocked.
A flighted on off, Shah drives it to long off for a single.
A flat delivery on leg, Wasim works it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! A full pitched delivery on off, Imad Wasim picks the googly and strikes it way past the bowler for a boundary.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Short outside off, cut to gully by Yasir but for no run.
Flatter one on the pads, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another short one outside off and some turn away from the southpaw. Imad mistimes his cut towards deep cover for a single.
Shorter one outside off, cut away by Wasim through point. A couple of runs are taken.
Flighted outside off and turning into the right-hander, Yasir drops it towards the off side and sets off for a quick run.

A back of a length on leg, Imad keeps it away.
Short outside off, Yasir Shah cuts it through point for a single.
Full on off, defended.
Full on leg, Shah keeps it away.
A nice flighted delivery on off, Imad dances down and makes it a full toss. Drives it to covers for a single.
Adam Zampa to bowl now.
Another defensive push by Yasir to end the over. The ball rolls to cover.
Flighted and full on middle, Yasir drives it back towards the bowler.
Shorter outside off, Shah remains in the crease and pushes the ball to cover.
Bowls this one quicker and on the pads of Yasir, he just runs it fine on the leg side. Picks up a couple of runs to get off the mark.
Flighted outside off, Wasim drives this past cover for a single.

Bowls this really short outside off, Imad looks to cut but the ball takes an inside edge and goes between the keeper's legs. The slip fielder runs to the ball and stops it though, preventing any runs.

A short pitch delivery on middle, Imad pulls it to square leg for a single.
Same length on off, Wasim punches it straight to Maxwell at point. Who misfields it but does not give away any run.
A back of a length delivery on off, Wasim blocks it.
A back of a length delivery on leg which skids on to batsman, Imad keeps it away.

On a length outside off, Imam makes room and slashes at the ball. It flies on a couple of bounces to third man.
A back of a length delivery on off, Akmal hit it straight to point.
Quicker one on off, beats Akmal who was looking to work it towards the third man region.
A back of a length delivery on leg, Akmal blocks it.

A short delivery on off, Wasim cuts it straight to covers.

WIDE! Maxwell starts his over with a wide. And that brings up the 50-run stand between the pair.
Back of length delivery on leg, Imad flicks it for a single.
First bouncer for the over! A well attempted bouncer, Akmal was looking for a pull but failed.
Back of a length, Wasim guides it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Imad Wasim decides to go aerial. A full length delivery on off, Imad comes down the track and lofts it above covers and gets a one bounce four.
A short delivery outside off, Akmal guides it to the third man region for a single.
WIDE! Full length delivery drifting outside leg. Wide signaled by the umpire.
A back of a length on leg, Akmal keeps it away.
Jason Behrendorff returns. 6-1-18-0 so far.
Outside off, punched past the bowler towards long off for one.
Oohhh... tries to be too cheeky, attempts a run down to third man but misses.
Fired on middle, helped straight to square leg.
Comes down the track but flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, pushed towards point. Akmal wants a single but is sent back.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
A back of a length delivery on off, Wasim punches it to covers for a single.

Dropped! Lazy stuff from Behrendorff. Too casual. A nice tossed up delivery on middle, Akmal dances down the track and looks to go big but does not quite get the distance. The ball goes towards long on where Jason Behrendorff comes under the ball but plonks it! Did the fielder coming in from long off come in his eyes? Perhaps. A single taken.

A flat delivery on middle, Akmal steps down and fails to read the flight of delivery, applies a defense but the ball hits his pads and goes to the wicket keeper Alex Carey who gathers the ball but couldn't flick the bails off.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point where a misfield enables a single.
Short and outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, punched behind point for a single.

Full on off, defended.
A flatted delivery on off, Akmal just tucks it to covers and runs for a single.
Maxwell flights this on of off, Imad drives it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Hammered! A tossed up delivery on middle, Imad just gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes it over mid on.
A back of length on off, Akmal plays it late towards the point region for a single.
Glenn Maxwell is back. 2-0-8-1 so far.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! A nice tossed up delivery on off, Akmal comes down to the track to the pitch of the ball and delivers a beautiful drive towards the cover region for a boundary.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards fine leg for a single.

Huge shout for LBW but turned down. Did that pitch outside leg? Zampa has his hands over his head. Australia do not review. Tossed up, Wasim misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Hawk Eye shows the ball to be pitched in line but spinning down the leg side.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total. 11 from the over.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.

Outside off, Akmal plays this very late, past the gloves of the keeper. Jason Behrendorff gives it a good chase from short third man, slides, pushes the ball back, loses his cap and then almost looks to return the cap instead of the ball! Three runs taken.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Down the leg side, helped through square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Akmal rocks back and pulls it wide of mid on for a boundary!
Full on leg, Imad looks to work it towards the leg side, but fails to connect and the ball hits his pads.
A flighted delivery on off, Imad puts it away.
Full on off, driven to mid off.
A flatter delivery on middle, Wasim defends it gets inside edge onto pads.
A flatter delivery on off, Akmal drives it long off for a single.
A nice floated delivery on leg, Imad makes a full toss and places it mid-wicket for a single.
A back of length on off, Wasim flicks it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
A full length delivery on off, Imad defends it.
Full on leg, Imad works it towards mid-wicket for a single.

A quicker one in the air, Wasim defends watchfully.
Full on leg, Imad keeps it away.
A short of length delivery on off, Akmal late cuts it straight to short third man.

Beaten! What a delivery from Lyon! A straighter one, an arm ball outside off. Akmal looks to prod forward and defend the ball but is beaten by the lack of spin there. Goes narrowly past the outside edge.
Pushed towards cover by Akmal coming forward.

Malik was looking solid in this innings, he just gave his wicket away. The trick to back Lyon back on attack worked for Finch.
Back of a length on off, Malik keeps it away.

Thrown up outside off, Akmal reaches out and drives it through the covers for another run.
Tossed up outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for one.

A short delivery on off, Malik flicks it to mid-wicket but fails to connect the bat with the ball. The ball hits his body and he runs for a single.
A well attempted bouncer. Malik ducks under it.
A full length delivery around leg and middle, Akmal flicks it to fine leg and picks a single.
A back of length delivery around off, Malik flicks this towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
A back of length delivery on off, Malik guides it straight to Maxwell at point.
Full on off, defended watchfully.
A length delivery on off, Malik cover drives it for a single.

Full on leg, Akmal keeps it away.

Full on off, defended.
A tossed up delivery on off, Akmal drives it to sweeper cover for a single.

A back of a length delivery outside off, Malik goes on back foot and punches it through covers for a double.
A back of a length delivery on off, Akmal works it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
WIDE! That was WILD! A back of length on leg and angled away to a huge wide outside leg.
A good length delivery outside off, Akmal lets it go.
Outside off, Akmal lets it go.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
A good length delivery on off, Malik defends it.
Pat Cummins returns. 5-1-11-3 so far.
A short of length on middle, Akmal blocks it from his back foot.
A length delivery on leg, Akmal flicks it straight to mid-wicket.

Umar Akmal comes in at a probably make-or-break stage in his career. Meanwhile, Drinks has been taken. Pakistan have been pegged back by the fall of the wicket just before the break. They need the partnership of Akmal and Malik to take them as close as possible and at a good speed otherwise it is looking difficult for the hosts. As for the visitors, they will try to keep it tight and pile up the pressure even more on Pakistan.

Because the ball skids through, beats his bat and hits him on the pad. Maxwell roars an LBW shout and the umpire agrees. Imam though wants the review but Hawk Eye does not support him.
Review time again! Imam the man in question once more. He has been adjudged LBW this time and has asked for a second opinion. Height could be the issue...

Down the leg side, flicked straight to square leg.

Full on off, A length delivery on off. Imam plays it late, from his front foot just guides it towards the third man region. Batsmen showing great running takes three.
A nice flighted delivery on off, Imam plays a defense but gets an outside edge and the ball falls short of the slip fielder.
A short pitch delivery on off, Imam rocks back and cuts it way pass the point region for a double.
A back of a length delivery around off, Imam goes on his back foot and flicks it mid-wicket for a couple.
Full on leg, Malik guides it to short fine leg for a single. And that brings 50-run stand between the pair.
A back of length delivery around off, Malik flicks it straight to mid on.
Shortens the length this time does Maxwell, Imam flicks it towards the leg side for no run though.
Flatter on middle and fuller slightly, Imam defends it with a straight bat.
Flatter outside off, Imam rocks back and cuts this away through point for 2 runs. That is well-placed shot.
Malik goes for the sweep this time but the ball comes off the under edge and runs fine on the leg side for a single.
Fuller one on the pads, Shoaib Malik drives this one through the region to the left of mid-wicket. 2 runs are taken till long on comes around.
Pushed to mid-wicket coming slightly ahead by Malik.
Around the wicket, Maxwell errs in line first up. Bowls this down the leg side, signalled wide by the umpire.
Here comes Glenn Maxwell.
On middle and leg, helped straight to square leg.
On middle, whipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Comes down the track and hits it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Malik looks to run it down to third man but is beaten.
Full and around off, defended back to the bowler.
A nice flighted delivery on off, Malik comes down the track and beautifully drives it towards the sweeper cover region. Pat Cummins guarding that region cuts it off and batsmen take a couple.

Excellent fielding from Mr. Committed. Malik swings this to the leg side and gets the ball through the vast vacant area through mid-wicket. Pat Cummins, probably one of the most committed Australian cricketers, races across the turf to his left, slides and then parries it across to Nathan Lyon running from long on. Three runs taken.
Half volley outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Full and around off, driven straight to cover.
Around middle and off, worked straight to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.

Not out! Umpire changes his decision. A full length delivery around off, the ball spun away from Imam after pitching. Imam was looking for a defense gets beaten. Looks like the ground umpire gave decision on sound as the bat was hitting the pad. But replays shows the ball was miles away from the bat.
Big shout and given! Imam has been adjudged caught behind but he has immediately taken the review...
A floated delivery on middle, Imam was looking for a defense gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Full on off, defended
A flatter delivery pitching outside off, Malik just places it to covers and runs for a single.

On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full on middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Around off, defended towards point.
Full and around off, Malik drives this straight down the ground past the bowler for a single.
A back of a length around leg, Malik flicks it to square leg for a single.
Back of a length, Imad places it to covers for a single.
A back of a length delivery on off, Imam tries a late cut but gets an inside edge, onto his pads. A soft appeal by Lyon, umpire is unmoved.

A short delivery on off, Imam punches it to covers for a single.
A flatter delivery on off, Imam puts it away.

Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
On a good length around off, solidly defended towards point.
FIVE WIDES! Bonus for Pakistan and they will certainly not mind. A bouncer, around middle, rises steeply after pitching and poor Carey has no chance. 229 more needed from 225 balls now.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Around middle and leg, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
A prod ahead from the Pakistan skipper to end the over. Looked a tad tentative there.
Left alone outside off by Malik.

Defended back to the bowler by Imam.

Malik dabs this one outside off on a length to third man for a single through the gully region.
This one keeps a tad low on middle stump line, Imam does well to remain nice and low to keep the ball out.
Good tight stuff from Imam, he pats it towards point. Looks for a single but decides against it in the end.
At the pads of Malik, pushed away to mid-wicket for a single.
On the middle stump line by Marcus, Malik defends it calmly back to the bowler.
On a length again outside off, dabbed down to third man for a run by Imam. He gets to the other end.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, left alone by the southpaw.

Full on off, Malik defends it. And that ends the Powerplay 1 with Pakistan on 21/3, whereas Australia were 48/2.
Same length on leg, the ball skid this time from the pitch and the ball hits Malik's thigh pads.
Back of length on middle, Malik watchfully blocks it.
A good length delivery on leg, Imam flicks it to fine leg for a single.
A back of a length delivery on off, Imam blocks it.
Back of a length on off, Imam keeps it away.
This time, Imam opens the face of the bat and runs the ball down to third man. Picks up a single on the last ball and retains strike for the next over.
Bouncer! Imam ducks under it and lets the ball go.
Oooh! Good yorker, kept out equally well by Imam by bringing his bat down in time.
Left alone outside off by the southpaw on this occasion.
A length ball outside off, Imam stands tall and defends it towards extra cover.
A front foot push by Malik towards the right of the cover fielder. Malik sets off immediately and gets to the other end.

Imam flicks it to mid-wicket for a double.

A back of a length delivery outside off and coming in for Imam. Imam was looking to work it fine towards the mid-wicket region but was stuck on his crease. The ball hits his pads. A good shout from fielding side. Umpire denies the shout. Behrendorff discusses it with his captain but they decide not to go for a review. Replays show that height is also a factor for batsman being safe.
Full on off, driven to mid off.
Change of line by Beherendorff, pitching outside off, left alone by Imam.
A fuller length delivery on off, Imam puts it away.

OUT! It is indeed out. There is a spike on the Snickometer. Rizwan, the hero of the last match, the centurion has to head back with a duck to his name tonight. A length ball just outside off, Rizwan looks to defend it but the ball seems to have gone past his outside edge. There is an appeal from the bowler and the keeper but the umpire is unmoved. Pat Cummins forces his skipper to take it upstairs. The replays roll in, and guess what. There is indeed a nick on that. Rizwan departs. Pakistan in huge trouble here, having lost the third within 7 overs!
Is that a nick? Australia seem to be confident and have gone for the review. Rizwan has been adjudged not out on the caught behind appeal...

Mohammad Rizwan was just making his way in but along with him come the showers. The players are seen making their way out. Hopefully, this is a passing shower. Must be so frustrating for the players and us spectators alike.

Marsh out there takes a comfortable catch at a good height and Pakistan in a huge spot of bother here early on in their innings.

Pakistan and Imam are underway. A length ball at the pads, Imam flicks it away through square leg and runs the first run hard. He slips at the bowler's end and thus cannot come back for the second run.
On a length outside off, a defensive push by the southpaw to the cover region.

Excellent ball to start! Short of a length and tailing away from the lefty, Imam looked to initially defend the ball but then leaves it alone in the end. Good leave.

We are back for the chase. Imam-ul-Haq and Shan Masood are the two openers for Pakistan. Pat Cummins has the first new ball for Australia. 267 to win for the hosts and keep the series alive. Let's play!
